item.title: Roll with History: New dice collection embeds 15th-century chainmail and T-Rex fragments
item.description: FanRoll Dice partners with Mini Museum for "Roll with History", a new collection embedding real dinosaur fossils, chainmail, and meteorites into RPG dice.

item.title: The Bodhana Group and Onyx Path release therapeutic RPG Branch Riders
item.description: The Bodhana Group and Onyx Path Publishing have released Branch Riders, a new TTRPG that blends dimension-hopping adventure with therapeutic gaming tools.

item.title: Son of Oak’s Winter Sale: 40% off pre-orders and a charity vote on every purchase
item.description: Son of Oak's Winter Sale is live: Save up to 40% on Legend in the Mist pre-orders and direct 15% of your purchase to a charity of your choice.

item.title: Silent Læke: Twin Peaks meets tabletop in new card-based RPG
item.description: Newborn Games announces Silent Læke, a Twin Peaks-inspired TTRPG using cards instead of dice to solve a 1992 murder mystery.

item.title: Beyond the pledge manager: How BackerKit is changing the business of roleplaying games
item.description: The era of the lonely crowdfunding campaign might be ending. BackerKit CEO Maxwell Salzberg explains how collab-funding turns a solo sprint into a shared event and why prioritising community over competition offers a more sustainable path for indie publishers.

item.title: Check out the new featurette for Paramount’s chimp horror ‘Primate’
item.description: Paramount has released a new featurette for the upcoming release of Primate, and it gives us a much better idea of what to expect from Johannes Roberts (Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City) upcoming horror.

item.title: Matthew Mercer and Critical Role cast announced for MCM London 2026
item.description: ReedPop announces the cast of Critical Role, including Matthew Mercer and Ashley Johnson, will attend MCM Comic Con London in October 2026.

item.title: Cubicle 7 releases Starter Set and GM Screen for Warhammer: The Old World
item.description: Cubicle 7 has launched the Starter Set and GM Screen for Warhammer: The Old World Roleplaying Game. Explore the river port of Talagaad and the age of the Three Emperors.

item.title: Anime Limited becomes Toho subsidiary in strategic split from Plaion
item.description: Toho acquires Anime Limited and announces a new European HQ in London. Read about the new strategic alliance with Plaion and what it means for UK anime fans.

item.title: Routinely Itemised: RPG #340
item.description: Critical Role heads to London Comic Con, Steve Jackson Games brings back Toon and there are major staff changes at Wizards of the Coast.
